mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates applied to future corporate cash flows and increasing equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average 5-day forward return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts below 1.1 million units signals weakening consumer confidence and reduced durable goods demand, leading to lower corporate revenue expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in fewer than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and a rise in the unemployment rate signal a weakening manufacturing sector and labor market stress, indicating an impending economic slowdown that reduces corporate profitability and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 107.0 and UNRATE > 4.0 in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both INDPRO and UNRATE meet the trigger condition, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% combined with a stable CPIAUCSL indicates a tightening monetary policy regime that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.5 and CPIAUCSL < 250.0 in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in fewer than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term in a regression model has a negative coefficient with p > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 490 billion dollars signals strong consumer demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of instances despite RSAFS exceeding threshold, or the average 5-day return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 107.0 combined with a rising unemployment rate above 4.2% signals a contraction in manufacturing output and labor market deterioration, indicating an imminent economic downturn that reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 107.0 and UNRATE > 4.2 in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in fewer than 60% of triggered instances, or the joint effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth below 1.0% annualized, as measured by GDPC1, signals a weakening economy, reducing corporate investment and consumer spending, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in fewer than 60% of instances despite GDPC1 below 1.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
